content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I stopped without finding the red ball, so I've put the robot into rest mode.

I did three full head sweeps and walked about 3 m around the room. I saw desks, chairs, a suitcase, cardboard boxes, a cabinet and people, but no red ball. The red I saw was red chair seats and, in the bottom camera, the robot's own body parts.

The robot is now wedged between a chair and a cabinet near the back of the room, with its position at about x 1.97 m, y 1.70 m from where it started. It's in a crouch, and motors are off.

To continue, someone could move the chairs and suitcase out of the way or point the robot toward an open area in front of it. Then I can search again.
